subject: ChatGPT prompts for content creators
audience: Short-form creators (Reels/Shorts) who already use ChatGPT and get generic, samey output from 'write me a viral script' prompts
core_value: Five copy-ready ChatGPT prompts for a creator's actual workflow (voice, ideas, hooks, script, repurpose), each of which starts from the creator's own material, and why that is what separates them from AI slop
desired_action: Save the reel for the next script
tone: Plain, practical, a little blunt. No hype, no 'secret prompts'. Prompts shown in their real published wording.
footage_constraints: ANIMATED TREATMENT: facePlan bookends (presenter circle on hook + CTA), slide scenes, music on, captions on, no credits. Proof = the real published prompt on the publisher's own page (OpenAI Academy, Descript, Sprout Social), captured mobile; logged-out chatgpt.com mobile for the hook; YouTube's policy page for the payoff. Academy prompt table clips on mobile -> desktop crop, reason recorded.
